title: Curious Builder
lines: Tum sawaal poochte ho jo baaki log sochte bhi nahi.
Ek naya gadget mile toh pehle khol ke dekhte ho.
Agla bada idea tumhare notebook ke margin mein hai.

title: Calm Strategist
superpower: Chaos mein bhi plan bana lena
lines: Group project mein sab tumhari taraf dekhte hain.
Tum 3 step aage soch lete ho, chupchaap.

title: Creative Spark
superpower: Boring cheez ko cool bana dena
lines: Tumhari notes mein doodles bhi kaam ke hote hain.
Tum ek idea ko 5 tareeke se dekh sakte ho.
Tumhari playlist hi tumhara vibe hai.
tvLine: Idea mile toh rang bhar do.

title: Team Energy
lines: Tum aate ho toh room ki energy badh jaati hai.
Dost tumse advice lene aate hain.
Tumhari smile ek free power-up hai.

title: Logic Ninja
lines: Tumhe shortcut dhoondhna pasand hai, aur milta bhi hai.
Tum debugging ko game ki tarah khelte ho.

title: Bold Explorer
lines: Naya try karne mein tum sabse aage ho.
Galti se seekhna tumhari speciality hai.
Tumhara 'chalo karte hain' sabko inspire karta hai.
